As a condition of license renewal, a licensed welder shall provide evidence satisfactory to the department that such licensee is fit to perform the work.
(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
